title: [Epic] v17 bug focus — Seat B: console bugs (objectui + repo:objectui)
body:
Theme charter for the post-v17 priority regime — sibling of #8667 (Seat A: platform bugs). Filed by the (former) skills PM seat, session `session_018WuTtyckQa1VcXwgd52JpN`, on maintainer instruction. Authority rulings are quoted verbatim on #8667 and apply to both seats identically (scope = objectstack + objectui only; marker = `target:v17`; epics ordered by 「把两张主题卡（epic）开出来」).

## Scope

The console/UI surface, spanning two trackers:

1. **objectui repo** — all open `bug`-labeled cards (9 at filing): objectstack-ai/objectui#4308, #4296, #4269, #4230, #4028, #4020, #3318, plus the two already marked dispatched (#4032, #3670 — see orphan re-verification below).
2. **objectstack repo** — open bugs/P0s labeled `repo:objectui`: #8500, #8499, #8282, #8096, #8270, #8018.

Workability rule is the same default flip as #8667: only `target:v17` cards are workable; the PM nominates second-batch candidates on this epic and the maintainer approves before they enter the queue.

## First batch (pending the maintainer's P0 rulings)

- #8500 — record-detail header action `visible` CEL fails against lookup fields and fail-opens silently (P0)
- #8282 — accept-invitation page names neither organization nor role (P0)
- #8096 — single-org users have no UI path to workspace manage pages (P0)
- #8270 — EE workspace owner lacks `manage_metadata`; the home-page primary CTA dead-ends (P0)
- objectstack-ai/objectui#4230 — REGRESSION: console header bell panel dead again while the API returns rows

## Before dispatching anything — two mandatory pre-work items

1. **Re-verify the 8 orphaned `pm:dispatched` cards in objectui** (the repo:objectui lane seat, #6025, has been silent since 2026-08-10; its dispatches are unaccounted for): objectstack-ai/objectui#4636, #4633, #4032, #3670, #4280, #4163, #4109, #4036. **#4636 first** — it raises the `@objectstack/spec` pin from `^17.0.0-rc.6` to 17.0.0 GA. Until it lands, every console-side bug verification runs against rc.6, so it gates the whole theme.
2. **Grade the bare-card backlog the triage seat flagged three consecutive rounds** (memo on #6025, 2026-08-13T05:54Z): 7 ungraded cards in objectui including #4508 (`needs-user-decision` — chart null-category identity collisions, pending a maintainer sentence), #4487, #4479. Grade for one question only: is it a v17 bug? If yes, nominate for `target:v17`; if no, freeze.

## Operating rules

Identical to #8667: WIP ≤3; pull order `priority:p0` > `pm:blocking` > `security` > age; bug-fix PRs ride the normal merge queue with auto-merge allowed (objectui repo conventions and worktree-first per its own AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md); claim discipline, os-dev dispatch protocol, model tiering, union-after-final-commit with quoted HEAD all unchanged. Round reports on this epic; the lane seat post #6025 stays ⏳ vacant and points here; the PM session registers with a claim comment and de-registers on stand-down.

## Done means

Every in-scope `target:v17` bug is closed (fixed, or ruled defer/void with the ruling recorded); the four console P0s carry an explicit maintainer disposition; the 8 orphaned dispatches are each closed out or cleanly re-dispatched; the 7-card grading backlog is zero.
